import requests

# Step 1: Retrieve the list of allergens
allergens_response = requests.get("https://api.socbench.example/allergens")
allergens_data = allergens_response.json()
allergens_list = allergens_data.get("allergens", [])

# Step 2: Retrieve the supply chain overview
supply_chain_response = requests.get("https://api.socbench.example/supplychain/overview")
supply_chain_data = supply_chain_response.json()

# Step 3: Identify possible allergens in the supply chain
possible_allergens = []
for segment in supply_chain_data:
    for allergen in allergens_list:
        if allergen.lower() in segment.get("description", "").lower():
            possible_allergens.append(allergen)

# Remove duplicates
possible_allergens = list(set(possible_allergens))

# Output the possible allergens
print("Possible allergens in the supply chain:", possible_allergens)
